views.rationale: AAPL's first quarter sales are 20% higher than other quarters, while CAT's sales are flat.
AMZN's sales growth is driven by increased customer usage, while BAC's revenue is declining.

BA's cost of sales is decreasing due to lower revenue and lower reach-forward losses, while CVX's sales and other operating revenues are decreasing due to lower refined product, crude oil, and natural gas prices.
GOOGL's 20% revenue growth outpaces GS's 6% net revenue growth
GOOGL's 20% revenue growth far exceeds JNJ's 0.2% sales growth
KO's 6% net operating revenue growth is less than LIN's 14.3% operating profit growth
NVDA's gross margin increased 1.2% year-over-year, while MSFT's gross margin increased 18%.
PG's gross margin increased 180 basis points to 51.0%, while NEE's gross margin was relatively flat.
